extension.description: Unofficial Kodi client for the Hungarian streaming service filmio.hu. Not affiliated with Filmio or Nemzeti Filmintézet.
Nem hivatalos Kodi kliens a filmio.hu magyar streaming szolgáltatáshoz. Nem áll kapcsolatban a Filmióval vagy a Nemzeti Filmintézettel.
extension.disclaimer: Requires your own Filmio account. Not endorsed by Filmio. Ids and clearlogos come from TMDB: this add-on uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
extension.news: 1.5.0: search history: the Search menu lists your recent searches (stored only on this device); remove one or clear all from the context menu. Remember password (Settings > Account, on by default): an expired session signs in again by itself, and Sign in is pre-filled. The main menu no longer has Genres: Films and Series have their own By genre lists. Menus and the Filmio info panel are Hungarian by default, whatever language Kodi uses; Settings > General > Use Kodi's language switches back. IMDb rating and Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer from the mapping on films and series (IMDb is the rating the skin shows by default); while browsing they also head the plot (Settings > General > Ratings above the plot). 0.9.0: richer info from TMDB for mapped titles (cast with photos and roles, writers, studios, countries, tagline, rating, premiere, original title); Filmio data stays the base. 0.8.3: the short TMDB v3 API key is the default for personal builds and the setting. 0.8.2: personal builds can embed your TMDB key (tools/build_zip.py --embed-tmdb-key); the setting still wins. 0.8.1: clearlogo artwork looked up from TMDB with your own TMDB key (Settings > General); not part of the public mapping. 0.8.0: clearlogo artwork on films, series, episodes and the playing item. 0.7.1: external id mapping switched on (857 Filmio titles with TMDB/IMDb ids). 0.7.0: TMDB/IMDb ids from an external mapping file (off until MAPPING_URL is set); the playing item now carries full metadata (title, year, show, season, episode). 0.6.0: Android / Android TV is the target platform; removed the unused header-override and service-certificate experiments. 0.5.6: playback heartbeat on its own thread (exact 5 s, also on Android); thread-safe token refresh. 0.5.5: no service certificate by default (broke DRM setup on Android). 0.5.4: add-on icon and fanart. 0.5.3: license header override is developer config only (filmio/config.py), off by default; removed from Settings. 0.5.1: license requests sent the web player headers (no effect: still 403). 0.5.0: My list (add/remove from the context menu), Filmio resume points and watched marks, 15-minute menu cache with a Clear cache button. 0.4.3: a failed start no longer saves a resume position. 0.4.2: Widevine privacy mode (server certificate), as the web player uses. 0.4.1: diagnostic license probe in debug mode. 0.4.0: playback (DASH + Widevine via InputStream Adaptive), playback-session heartbeat and progress sync. 0.3.0: sign in / sign out (email and password). Continue watching and My list when signed in. 0.2.1: going back to search results no longer re-opens the keyboard. 0.2.0: catalogue browsing (home rows, films, series, animation, genres, decades, search). Playback not yet available. 0.1.0: installable skeleton with menu.

extension.description: Browse and play the publicly available on-demand programmes of mediaklikk.hu, the Hungarian public media site. Unofficial; not affiliated with MTVA.
A mediaklikk.hu nyilvánosan elérhető, visszanézhető műsorainak böngészése és lejátszása. Nem hivatalos kiegészítő; nem áll kapcsolatban az MTVA-val.
extension.news: 1.5.0: first release through the add-on repository. The version is above the older community MédiaKlikk add-on (1.3.0), so Kodi does not replace this one with it. 0.6.4: search fixed (it returned to the main menu); search history. 0.6.3: fanart with the full MédiaKlikk logo. 0.6.2: add-on icon and fanart. 0.6.1: ongoing programmes (lists that do not start at episode 1) keep newest first; unreliable episode numbers are ignored. 0.6.0: programmes without seasons are listed in episode order, with descriptions and lengths where the site provides them. 0.5.0: Films menu and "Latest videos" in every genre (stand-alone videos that belong to no programme). 0.4.0: playback (HLS with Kodi's own player, Hungarian subtitles when available). 0.3.0: programme pages with seasons and episode lists. Playback not yet available. 0.2.0: programme catalogue (all programmes, genres, search). Episodes and playback not yet available. 0.1.0: installable skeleton with menu.

extension.summary: Ceto nem hivatalos Kodi kiegészítői (Filmio, MédiaKlikk)
extension.description: Installs and updates the unofficial community add-ons Filmio and MédiaKlikk. These add-ons are independent projects and are not affiliated with, or endorsed by, Filmio, the National Film Institute Hungary, MTVA or MédiaKlikk.

A nem hivatalos, közösségi Filmio és MédiaKlikk kiegészítők telepítése és frissítése. Független projektek, nem állnak kapcsolatban a Filmióval, a Nemzeti Filmintézettel, az MTVA-val vagy a MédiaKlikkel, és azok nem támogatják őket.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial community add-ons. Content, trademarks and rights belong to their respective owners.
